cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name Your Backers
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before I tell the workshop staff they're closing, who backed your decision?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director approved it. Please just send the notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll name her approval. Who else supported it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sales. They're getting the floor space, but leave them out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then Sales can join the staff meeting. Who signed off on giving them our space?

mechanism: A corrects its pupil incomplete accountability report by extracting the approving leader, supporting beneficiary, and authority for the benefit.
confusable: Not just identifying a final decider: A wants the network of backers and who profits exposed.
comparison: Workshop closure recipients versus cheaper roof beneficiaries.
